headline: Pasuruan flooding narrows to Beji district
summary: Per 13 Januari 2026, genangan banjir di Kabupaten Pasuruan tersisa di Kecamatan Beji, yaitu beberapa dusun di Desa Kedungringin setinggi 10–30 cm dan berangsur turun; kecamatan lain sudah dinyatakan surut (BPBD Jawa Timur).
summary_id: Per 13 Januari 2026, genangan banjir di Kabupaten Pasuruan tersisa di Kecamatan Beji, yaitu beberapa dusun di Desa Kedungringin setinggi 10–30 cm dan berangsur turun; kecamatan lain sudah dinyatakan surut (BPBD Jawa Timur).
summary_en: As of 13 January 2026, flooding in Kabupaten Pasuruan was confined to Beji district, where several hamlets in Kedungringin village stood under 10–30 cm of water and receding; other districts had drained (BPBD East Java).
